baseTestStatus.description: Test method status (PASSED, SKIPPED, etc.) from the "base" report

compareTestStatus.description: Test method status (PASSED, SKIPPED, etc.) from the "compare" report

title:
Instances of {@link TestMethodComparisonStatus} are created after comparing two junit test reports to identify the
differences between the two test runs. Test execution status of each test (method) is captured from both "base" and
"compare" report to make the comparison easier.

A test maybe:
1. Present in both "base" and "compare" reports.
2. Present in only "compare", indicating that it's a potentially newly added test.
3. Present in only "base", indicating that it maybe deleted/refactored in the "compare" run.

An array of **TestMethodComparisonStatus** obtained from {@link #fromJunitReports} may be processed in different
ways to help manage different initiatives involving migration, feature revamping or simply addressing tech debt.
name: TestMethodComparisonStatus
